Hi Tessa / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick sync this morning. Per our call, attaching the initial volunteer shift matrix (attached as volunteer_shifts_v3.xlsx) and a low-res floor sketch. Two asks from our side before we lock printing and the volunteer check-in scripts: 

1) Can you confirm the final check-in desk location on the floor plan (we currently have it at Gate C near the east aisle) — we need that for the badge printer run.
2) We need the CAD file for the booth footprint and the surrounding sightlines so our on-site team can place the tent/cards and crate labels correctly.

Also tagging PrintWorks (cc'ed Gina) — if you can sign off on the crate-label template, we can batch-print the vinyl labels overnight.

Thanks Ava — this looks like a good starting point. A few action items from Redwood ops/marketing: 

- Tessa: I'll share the booth CAD and a cleaner vector of the floor map by 3pm PT. That will include the exact check-in coordinates (lat/long-esque grid from the venue CAD) so you can program the badge printer.
- Marissa: can you confirm the crate-label color lockup (we usually go with Pantone 295 C for the Redwood stripes) and the short phrasing we want on the label? Ava asked for a one-line copy (e.g., "REDF: BOOTH A14 - CONTENTS: DEMO KITS").
- Logan: can you check that the east service lane will be clear between 0700-0930 on load-in day? The volunteer arrival window is 0730-0830 and we need a clear path.

Ava — we can do a small run of 200 labels for day one to stage in the check-in crates and then top up later. If PrintWorks can do a waterproof vinyl, that would be ideal.

I'll attach the CAD here in the next email.

Best,

Thanks — looping in a couple of quick creative/print constraints so we don't have to iterate later: 

- Copy: keep it short for the crate label. Proposal: "REDF - BOOTH A14 / DEMO KITS" (all caps, 22pt). If you want model numbers appended, we'll leave a secondary slot on the template.
- Color: Pantone 295 C background, white type. Avoid gradients — vinyl prints lose fidelity at the edges.
- Size: 4" x 6" recommended; PrintWorks can do a die-cut for the carrying handles.

Karthik — can you confirm a volunteer will be assigned to AV handoff at 10:15 on Day 1? We need a point to receive the headset packs and quick-check the demo laptops.

I'll review the CAD when Tessa sends it and flag any sightlines that require uprights to be moved 6" left for accessibility.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Events Producer, Redwood Inference

Quick ops update after I spoke with venue logistics: 

- Service lane: east lane is available but only between 0600-0900 on load-in day (venue block). We'll request an escort after 0900 but unloading after 0900 is not guaranteed. Move all crate pickups to the 0600-0830 window if possible.
- Power: booth power drops are at the northeast corner of the footprint; runs longer than 20' will need soft cords — order placed with AV.
- Attached: expo-floor-map-v2.pdf (annotated with recommended check-in desk at Grid E3 on Level 1).

Tessa — if you can confirm volunteer shift start at 0730 and a dock liaison at 0630, I'll lock in the dock times with the venue. Also, I'll drop an ops volunteer at 1015 for the AV handoff (Marissa / Karthik noted).

Attachments: expo-floor-map-v2.pdf
